_schema: Score for one placement = cellsPlaced * perCell + linesCleared * perLine * comboMultiplier[linesCleared] * streakMultiplier[min(streak, last)]. streak = consecutive placements that each cleared at least one line, counted before this placement; it resets to 0 on a placement that clears nothing (HANDOFF R9, R15). comboMultiplier is indexed by lines cleared on this placement (index 0 unused). streakMultiplier is indexed by streak and the last entry repeats for longer streaks. Every number is an UNVERIFIED starting value; the bot and live data tune them.
